policy: ACTIVE_PUSH is exactly one workflow targeting audit/full-repository-snapshot-20261122.
Historical workflow must not trigger push to main or integration, and any pull_request trigger must have an explicit retired branch target.
No workflow is granted contents:write at top or job level; legacy V5 writeback is deliberately dormant and cannot perform a bot push.
All 25 historical workflows remain in Git history for traceability, but do not constitute required current CI.
The read-only full-repository snapshot workflow has workflow_dispatch but cannot be presumed callable when not present on the default branch.
P0-0-04 must create ONE pinned Python 3.11.18 full integration CI and run V3/V5/V6/E1-E5 in actual common head; this audit does not certify that full suite.
Do not add experiment/video/version branches; main SHA remains protected by the read-only history guard.
At start and end of subsequent work, run workload policy and report exact checklist ID, CI/OPEN, main/ref status to user.
